blocks.text: PULILAN, Bulacan— The former mayor of Pulilan town in Bulacan was involved in a road accident last week that led to the death of a motorcycle rider she may have run over. Former Pulilan Mayor Ma. Rosario Ochoa, 71, was driving an SUV when two motorcycles crashed into her path and may have accidentally driven over Jeffrey Lopez, 46, at about 6:40 a.m. on Nov. 6 along Esguerra Street in Barangay Penabatan, the Inquirer learned on Monday. Ochoa had just completed her three consecutive terms as Pulilan mayor in 2025. READ: 3 motorcycle riders die in Quezon road crashes Lopez was […]...
